title: Home Ahead demo, live model
note: The shorter cut recorded with a live model (npm run video -- --live). Played by the simulator at /?demo=1&script=live. The replies are whatever the model says on the day.

steps.text: This take runs on a live model: Claude Opus 5.5 in a Strands agent. The panel on the right logs every tool call and model turn.
My sister gave us her old high chair. The label says TB-HC6900.
steps.speak: My sister gave us her old high chair. The label says T B, H C, six nine zero zero.

steps.text: She pulled herself up on the couch today!
Without a key, or if the model is slow or down, the deterministic planner answers with the same tools.
